# CoreStory

CoreStory maps how a codebase actually works, from applications and processes down to business rules, each traced to the code behind it, and serves that map to coding agents over MCP.

Download (desktop app for macOS on Apple silicon and Linux x64; command-line tool for macOS, Linux and Windows): https://get.corestory.ai/
Setup guide: https://get.corestory.ai/#setup
Connect a coding agent: https://get.corestory.ai/#connect
Latest release: https://github.com/CoreStory-Frontier/release-dist/releases

Agent Skills catalog (machine-readable): https://get.corestory.ai/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json
Installable skills: https://github.com/CoreStoryAI/agent-skills

Plot container preview: https://get.corestory.ai/container/
Plot container source: https://github.com/CoreStory-Frontier/plot-container-poc

Benchmarks: https://corestory.ai/research/v3-benchmarks
Documentation: https://docs.corestory.ai
